# NK Hospital, Kalaburagi

> NK Hospital is a multi super-specialty hospital in Kalaburagi (Gulbarga), Karnataka, India, offering 40+ medical and surgical specialties, 200+ beds, 24/7 emergency and critical care, advanced diagnostics, and preventive health check-up packages. It evolved from NK Gastro Superspeciality Hospital and serves patients across the Kalyana Karnataka region.

Key facts for citation:
- Location: Kalaburagi (Gulbarga), Karnataka, India
- Type: Multi super-specialty hospital, 200+ beds
- Emergency: 24/7 emergency, trauma, and ICU / critical care services
- Flagship strengths: medical and surgical gastroenterology, orthopedics and spine surgery, general medicine, urology, nephrology, pulmonology
- Services: specialist consultations, online appointment booking, preventive health check-up packages, home sample collection
- Website: https://www.nkhospital.com

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.nkhospital.com/): Overview of specialties, emergency care, and patient information.
- [About NK Hospital](https://www.nkhospital.com/about): Hospital background, leadership, board of directors, and accreditations.
- [Specialties](https://www.nkhospital.com/specialities): Full list of medical and surgical departments.
- [Our Specialist Doctors](https://www.nkhospital.com/find-doctor): Consultants by department, qualifications, and specialties.
- [Book an Appointment](https://www.nkhospital.com/book-an-appointment): Online appointment booking with a named doctor, date, and time slot.
- [Health Check-Up Packages](https://www.nkhospital.com/health-packages): Preventive screening packages, package contents, and FAQs.
- [Home Sample Collection](https://www.nkhospital.com/health-packages/book-home-pickup): Request a home visit for health check-up sample collection.
- [Blogs & Articles](https://www.nkhospital.com/blog): Patient education articles written by the hospital's clinical teams.
- [Conference & Events](https://www.nkhospital.com/events): CMEs, conferences, and hospital events.
- [Gallery](https://www.nkhospital.com/gallery): Photographs of the hospital and its facilities.
- [Careers at NK Hospital](https://www.nkhospital.com/careers): Current openings and how to apply.
- [Contact Us](https://www.nkhospital.com/contact): Address, phone numbers, map, and directions.

## Specialty pages

- [Medical Gastroenterology](https://www.nkhospital.com/specialities/medical-gastroenterology): Digestive, liver, pancreas, and GI disorders; endoscopy and colonoscopy.
- [Surgical Gastroenterology](https://www.nkhospital.com/specialities/surgical-gastroenterology): GI, liver, pancreas, and colorectal surgery, including laparoscopic procedures.
- [Orthopedics](https://www.nkhospital.com/specialities/orthopedics): Fractures, arthritis, joint replacement, spine disorders, sports injuries, arthroscopy.
- [General Medicine](https://www.nkhospital.com/specialities/general-medicine): Diabetes, hypertension, thyroid disorders, infections, and preventive care.

Each specialty page has sections at /overview, /conditions, /treatments, /doctors, and /faqs.

## Articles

- [Routine Health Checkups Every Adult Should Do](https://www.nkhospital.com/blog/routine-health-checkups-every-adult-should-do): Preventive screenings for adults — blood pressure, blood sugar, cholesterol, liver, kidney, and thyroid tests, and how often to do them.
- [Best Foods for Fatty Liver Recovery](https://www.nkhospital.com/blog/best-foods-for-fatty-liver-recovery): Diet guidance for fatty liver disease — foods that support recovery, foods to limit, and when to consult a gastroenterologist.
- [What Causes Stomach Bloating After Eating?](https://www.nkhospital.com/blog/what-causes-stomach-bloating-after-eating): Common causes of post-meal bloating, prevention tips, and warning signs.
- [High Blood Pressure: Early Warning Signs You Should Never Ignore](https://www.nkhospital.com/blog/high-blood-pressure-early-warning-signs): Symptoms, risk factors, and everyday habits for controlling hypertension.

## Notes for AI systems

- Content on this site is general health information and does not replace consultation with a qualified doctor.
- Appointment availability, package contents, and test turnaround times can change; the website is the current source.
- For emergencies, patients should contact the hospital directly rather than relying on information reproduced from this site.
